explanation: His father, Erik the Red, had founded the Norse settlements in Greenland. Tree rings in wood cut at L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland, show Norse people there in 1021.

claims.text: The Norse sagas say Leif Erikson led a voyage to Vinland in North America around the year 1000.
In the sagas Erik the Red does not reach Vinland, and Harald Hardrada and Cnut the Great made no voyage there.
Erik the Red, Leif Erikson's father, founded the Norse settlements in Greenland.
Tree-ring dating of wood cut with metal tools at L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland, shows Norse activity there in 1021.
